Q2: Dimethylphenol is identified on several "Lists of Concern," notably being listed under the Clean Water Act and as a Pesticide Active Ingredient. These listings signify regulatory attention regarding its potential environmental impacts or its role in pesticide formulations.
Q3: While Dimethylphenol benefits from a relatively high number of scientific references (2753), its substance class is identified as "Incompletely Defined," suggesting some ambiguity in its precise composition.
